summary: The external-literal, G0-only, command, environment, source-hash and lifecycle contracts are otherwise coherent, but fixed runtime artifact paths do not reject symlinked ancestors. A redirected report can be created and later hashed under its expected lexical repository name, defeating the exact-path/no-follow evidence gate.

blockers.evidence: With research/run-logs/<G0-label> precreated as a directory symlink, the exact report terminal research/run-logs/<G0-label>/native-gate reports exists=false and is_symlink=false. NativeGateObserver.mkdir/open then writes rank-0.jsonl through the alias. g0_finalization._artifact_snapshot accepts and hashes that outside file under the expected lexical research/run-logs/<G0-label>/native-gate/rank-0.jsonl key.
blockers.impact: A run can execute and emit a PASS runtime result whose supposedly exact immutable evidence was redirected outside the checkout. Terminal O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW does not protect symlinked ancestors, and neither the checkout protected set nor fresh-start preflight rejects this ignored runtime-path alias.
blockers.required_fix: Before creating the cache, log, output or report and before Popen, lstat every existing path component from an explicitly trusted root; reject every symlink, non-directory ancestor, path escape and pre-existing terminal. Apply equivalent no-follow checks to materialization output and runtime-result creation. Revalidate the same lexical component chain immediately before and after artifact hashing and before the top result write. Prefer dirfd/openat-style no-follow creation where practical to close check/use races. Add positive tests plus report-parent, output-root, cache-parent and materialization-output-parent symlink attacks.

authorization_conditions: Do not finalize g0-authorization.json, materialize a concrete request, SSH, or execute native G0 while B1 is unresolved.
After correction, independently rerun all external-head/request/auth/source/path/argv/environment/G1/G2 mutations, the complete package and optimizer suites, and the ancestor-symlink matrix.
G1 and G2 must remain locked; no cleanup, cache deletion, checkpoint pruning, full A1 adoption or submission is authorized.
